options: водка
водки
водку
водкой
cases.translation: I don't drink vodka every day.
cases.explain: «Пить» is a transitive verb, so its direct object stands in the accusative; feminine -а nouns take -у.

options: края
краю
краем
краёв
cases.translation: You came here, to these parts...
cases.explain: «В» with a verb of motion (приехать) answers «куда?» and takes the accusative; for inanimate plural the accusative looks like the nominative.

cases.sentence: За все время, пока мы с тобою знакомы, у меня ни одного ___ не было свободного.
options: день
дня
дню
днем
cases.translation: In all the time we have known each other, I haven't had a single free day.
cases.explain: Negated existence («не было») puts the missing thing in the genitive, and «ни одного» is itself a genitive quantifier.

options: человек
человека
человеком
человеке
cases.translation: In ten years I have become a different man.
cases.explain: The verb «стать» (to become) takes its complement in the instrumental case.

options: бог
бога
богу
богом
cases.translation: People will not remember, but God will remember.
cases.explain: The word is the subject of the verb «помянет», and subjects stand in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Самовар уже два часа на ___, а они гулять пошли.
options: стол
стола
столе
столом
cases.translation: The samovar has been on the table for two hours already, and they have gone off for a walk.
cases.explain: «На» meaning location («где?»), with no motion, requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Жарко, душно, а наш великий ученый в пальто, в калошах, с ___ и в перчатках.
options: зонтик
зонтика
зонтиком
зонтике
cases.translation: It's hot and stifling, and our great scholar is in an overcoat, in galoshes, with an umbrella and in gloves.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» in the sense of «together with / carrying» always governs the instrumental.

cases.sentence: А профессор по-прежнему от утра до глубокой ночи сидит у себя в ___ и пишет.
options: кабинет
кабинета
кабинете
кабинетом
cases.translation: And the professor, as before, sits in his study from morning till late at night and writes.
cases.explain: «В» answering «где?» (static location with «сидит») takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: ___, очевидно, он нравится, она влюблена в него.
options: Соня
Сони
Соне
Соней
cases.translation: Sonya evidently likes him, she is in love with him.
cases.explain: With «нравиться» the person who does the liking is the experiencer and stands in the dative.

cases.sentence: У меня образцовый сад и питомник, какого не найдете за тысячу ___ кругом.
options: верста
версты
верст
верстами
cases.translation: I have a model garden and nursery such as you won't find for a thousand versts around.
cases.explain: After a numeral or quantity word like «тысяча» the counted noun goes into the genitive plural.

reading.ru: Я не каждый день водку пью.
reading.question: How does Astrov answer when Marina offers him a drop of vodka?
options: He says he doesn't drink vodka every day
He says he has never touched vodka
He asks her to pour two glasses
He says he only drinks vodka in the evening
reading.correct: He says he doesn't drink vodka every day
reading.explain: He refuses the vodka, adding that he doesn't drink it every day and that it is stuffy anyway.

reading.ru: Ну, значит, лет одиннадцать прошло.
reading.question: How long does Marina reckon she and Astrov have known each other?
options: About eleven years
About two years
About twenty-five years
About fifty years
reading.correct: About eleven years
reading.explain: Marina works it out from the time Vera Petrovna was still alive and says about eleven years have gone by.

reading.ru: Заработался, нянька.
reading.question: What reason does Astrov give for having aged so much?
options: He has worked himself to exhaustion
He has been ill for years
He has been drinking since childhood
He has been travelling abroad
reading.correct: He has worked himself to exhaustion
reading.explain: He says he is on his feet from morning till night, knows no rest, and has not had one free day.

reading.ru: В Великом посту на третьей неделе поехал я в Малицкое на эпидемию...
reading.question: Where did Astrov go in the third week of Lent?
options: To Malitskoye, to an epidemic
To Kharkov, to a lecture
To the factory, to a patient
To the forestry, to plant trees
reading.correct: To Malitskoye, to an epidemic
reading.explain: He describes going to Malitskoye during a typhus epidemic and the filth he found in the peasant huts.

reading.ru: Люди не помянут, зато бог помянет.
reading.question: How does Marina answer Astrov's fear that people of the future will not remember them kindly?
options: She says people will not remember, but God will
She says everyone will remember him as a doctor
She says nobody should care about the future
She says he should ask the professor
reading.correct: She says people will not remember, but God will
reading.explain: Her simple reply comforts him and he thanks her for putting it well.

reading.ru: Сплю не вовремя, за завтраком и обедом ем разные кабули, пью вина... нездорово все это!
reading.question: How does Voynitsky describe his own life since the professor and his wife moved in?
options: He sleeps at the wrong times, eats rich food and drinks wine
He works harder than ever before
He has taken over all of Sonya's duties
He has stopped eating altogether
reading.correct: He sleeps at the wrong times, eats rich food and drinks wine
reading.explain: He says life has slipped off its rails: now Sonya works alone while he sleeps, eats and drinks.

reading.ru: Профессор встает в 12 часов, а самовар кипит с утра, все его дожидается.
reading.question: What does Marina complain about in the professor's daily routine?
options: He gets up at twelve while the samovar has been boiling since morning
He refuses to drink tea at all
He makes everyone eat at dawn
He never comes out of the garden
reading.correct: He gets up at twelve while the samovar has been boiling since morning
reading.explain: She also complains that dinner has moved from the first hour to the seventh and that he rings for tea in the middle of the night.

reading.ru: Мы завтра поедем в лесничество, папа.
reading.question: What does Sonya propose to her father when they come back from their walk?
options: A trip to the forestry the next day
A trip to town to see a doctor
That he should write his autobiography
That he should drink his tea in the garden
reading.correct: A trip to the forestry the next day
reading.explain: She invites him to the forestry and assures him he will certainly like it there.

reading.ru: Друзья мои, пришлите мне чай в кабинет, будьте добры!
reading.question: What does Serebryakov ask for when tea is announced?
options: That his tea be sent to his study
That the tea be made stronger
That everyone join him at the table
That the tea be served in the garden
reading.correct: That his tea be sent to his study
reading.explain: He excuses himself, saying he still has work to do today, and goes off into the house.

reading.ru: Жарко, душно, а наш великий ученый в пальто, в калошах, с зонтиком и в перчатках.
reading.question: How is Serebryakov dressed, according to Voynitsky?
options: In an overcoat, galoshes and gloves, with an umbrella
In light summer clothes without a hat
In a dressing gown and slippers
In his old professor's uniform
reading.correct: In an overcoat, galoshes and gloves, with an umbrella
reading.explain: Voynitsky mocks him for it in the heat, and Astrov dryly comments that the man takes care of himself.

reading.ru: Во всю жизнь не видел женщины красивее.
reading.question: What does Voynitsky say about Yelena Andreevna's looks?
options: That he has never in his life seen a more beautiful woman
That she is pretty but cold
That she looks like his late sister
That she is too young for the professor
reading.correct: That he has never in his life seen a more beautiful woman
reading.explain: He exclaims over her beauty and then dreamily says «Глаза... Чудная женщина».

reading.ru: Погода очаровательная, птички поют, живем мы все в мире и согласии, - чего еще нам?
reading.question: How does Telegin describe life on the estate?
options: Charming weather, singing birds, everyone living in peace and harmony
Dull, damp and full of quarrels
Hard work from morning till night
Lonely, since nobody visits them
reading.correct: Charming weather, singing birds, everyone living in peace and harmony
reading.explain: Telegin says that whatever he does he feels an inexpressible bliss, and thanks them warmly for his tea.

reading.ru: Он бы лучше свою автобиографию написал.
reading.question: What does Voynitsky say the professor would do better to write?
options: His own autobiography
A book about art
A pamphlet against Pavel Alekseevich
Nothing at all
reading.correct: His own autobiography
reading.explain: He calls it a splendid subject and then sketches that biography himself in mockery.

reading.ru: Живет эта вобла в имении своей первой жены, живет поневоле, потому что жить в городе ему не по карману.
reading.question: Why, according to Voynitsky, does the professor live on the estate?
options: Because he cannot afford to live in town
Because his doctor ordered country air
Because he loves the forests there
Because his mother-in-law asked him to
reading.correct: Because he cannot afford to live in town
reading.explain: Voynitsky says he lives there against his will, purely for lack of money, while complaining about his misfortunes.

reading.ru: Жена моя бежала от меня на другой день после свадьбы с любимым человеком по причине моей непривлекательной наружности.
reading.question: What happened to Telegin the day after his wedding?
options: His wife ran away with the man she loved
His wife fell seriously ill
He lost his estate at cards
He was called away to the army
reading.correct: His wife ran away with the man she loved
reading.explain: He blames his own unattractive appearance, and says he still loves her and has kept faith with her.

reading.ru: Заткни фонтан, Вафля!
reading.question: How does Voynitsky react when Telegin objects to his talk about marital fidelity?
options: He tells him irritably to shut up, calling him Waffle
He apologises to him at once
He agrees with him warmly
He walks away into the house
reading.correct: He tells him irritably to shut up, calling him Waffle
reading.explain: Voynitsky snaps at him with annoyance, and Telegin goes on with his own story anyway.

reading.ru: А я-то сломя голову скакал тридцать верст.
reading.question: Why is Astrov annoyed when he finds Serebryakov perfectly healthy?
options: Because he had galloped thirty versts at breakneck speed
Because he had cancelled an operation
Because he had lost a whole week of work
Because nobody offered him dinner
reading.correct: Because he had galloped thirty versts at breakneck speed
reading.explain: He was summoned by letter about the professor's rheumatism, but says he will at least stay the night and sleep.

reading.ru: Виноват-с... Не Иван Иваныч, а Илья Ильич-с...
reading.question: What does Telegin do when Yelena Andreevna calls him Ivan Ivanych?
options: He politely corrects her: he is Ilya Ilyich
He pretends not to hear her
He says he prefers to be called Vanya
He asks Sonya to introduce him again
reading.correct: He politely corrects her: he is Ilya Ilyich
reading.explain: He gives his full name, Ilya Ilyich Telegin, and explains that some call him Waffle because of his pockmarked face.

reading.ru: Опровергает то, что семь лет назад сам же защищал.
reading.question: What does Maria Vasilyevna find strange about the pamphlet she has received?
options: It refutes what its author himself defended seven years ago
It was printed without the author's name
It repeats the professor's own ideas
It is written in a language she cannot read
reading.correct: It refutes what its author himself defended seven years ago
reading.explain: The pamphlet came from Pavel Alekseevich in Kharkov, and she calls the contradiction awful.

reading.ru: Теперь мне сорок семь лет.
reading.question: How old is Voynitsky?
options: Forty-seven
Thirty-six
Fifty
Twenty-five
reading.correct: Forty-seven
reading.explain: He states his age while complaining that he has stupidly wasted the time when he could have had everything.

reading.ru: В такую погоду хорошо повеситься...
reading.question: How does Voynitsky answer Yelena Andreevna's remark that the weather is nice today?
options: He says it is good weather for hanging oneself
He agrees and suggests a walk
He says the heat is unbearable
He says nothing at all
reading.correct: He says it is good weather for hanging oneself
reading.explain: His gloomy joke follows her polite remark about the weather after an awkward pause.

reading.ru: Пеструшка ушла с цыплятами...
reading.question: Why is Marina walking about the house calling the hens?
options: The speckled hen has wandered off with her chicks
The workman has frightened the poultry
She wants to catch a hen for dinner
The peasants have come for the hens
reading.correct: The speckled hen has wandered off with her chicks
reading.explain: She is afraid the crows might carry them off, and goes out still calling «Цып, цып, цып».

reading.ru: Михаил Львович каждый год сажает новые леса, и ему уже прислали бронзовую медаль и диплом.
reading.question: What has Astrov received for his work with the forests?
options: A bronze medal and a diploma
A government pension
A new estate of thirty desyatinas
A place in the state forestry
reading.correct: A bronze medal and a diploma
reading.explain: Sonya defends his forestry work and reports the award he has been sent for planting new woods every year.

reading.ru: Ты можешь топить печи торфом, а сараи строить из камня.
reading.question: What does Astrov suggest Voynitsky do instead of using wood?
options: Heat the stoves with peat and build the sheds of stone
Buy timber from the state forestry
Plant a new wood every year himself
Stop building sheds altogether
reading.correct: Heat the stoves with peat and build the sheds of stone
reading.explain: He allows cutting forests out of need, but attacks the senseless destruction of them.

reading.ru: Соне, очевидно, он нравится, она влюблена в него, и я ее понимаю.
reading.question: What does Yelena Andreevna say about Sonya and the doctor?
options: That Sonya is evidently in love with him
That Sonya cannot stand him
That Sonya only admires his forests
That Sonya has never met him
reading.correct: That Sonya is evidently in love with him
reading.explain: Yelena finds the doctor's tired, nervous face interesting and says she understands Sonya's feelings.

reading.ru: Могу ли я смотреть на вас иначе, если я люблю вас?
reading.question: What does Voynitsky confess to Yelena Andreevna at the end of the act?
options: That he is in love with her
That he wants to leave the estate
That he hates his own mother
That he is going to sell the estate
reading.correct: That he is in love with her
reading.explain: He calls her his happiness, his life and his youth, and begs only to be allowed to look at her and hear her voice.

highlight.question: Which sentence says that Astrov has not had a single free day in all the time he and the nurse have known each other?
sentences: Заработался, нянька.
От утра до ночи все на ногах, покою не знаю, а ночью лежишь под одеялом и боишься, как бы к больному не потащили.
За все время, пока мы с тобою знакомы, у меня ни одного дня не было свободного.
Как не постареть?
Да и сама по себе жизнь скучна, глупа, грязна...
Затягивает эта жизнь.
highlight.explain: Only the third sentence mentions the whole period of their acquaintance and the absence of a single free day.

highlight.question: Which sentence says what time the household used to dine before the professor and his wife arrived?
sentences: Профессор встает в 12 часов, а самовар кипит с утра, все его дожидается.
Без них обедали всегда в первом часу, как везде у людей, а при них в седьмом.
Ночью профессор читает и пишет, и вдруг часу во втором звонок...
Что такое, батюшка?
Чаю!
Буди для него народ, ставь самовар...
highlight.explain: Marina contrasts the old dinner hour with the new one only in this sentence.

highlight.question: Which sentence gives the reason Telegin's wife left him?
sentences: Позволь, Ваня.
Жена моя бежала от меня на другой день после свадьбы с любимым человеком по причине моей непривлекательной наружности.
После того я своего долга не нарушал.
Я до сих пор ее люблю и верен ей, помогаю чем могу и отдал свое имущество на воспитание деточек, которых она прижила с любимым человеком.
Счастья я лишился, но у меня осталась гордость.
highlight.explain: He names his unattractive appearance as the cause of her flight in that sentence.

highlight.question: Which sentence explains where Telegin's nickname 'Vaflya' (Waffle) comes from?
sentences: Виноват-с...
Не Иван Иваныч, а Илья Ильич-с...
Илья Ильич Телегин, или, как некоторые зовут меня по причине моего рябого лица, Вафля.
Я когда-то крестил Сонечку, и его превосходительство, ваш супруг, знает меня очень хорошо.
Я теперь у вас живу-с, в этом имении-с...
Если изволили заметить, я каждый день с вами обедаю.
highlight.explain: The nickname is explained by his pockmarked face in the sentence where he gives his full name.

highlight.question: Which sentence tells us Voynitsky's age?
sentences: Я был светлою личностью...
Нельзя сострить ядовитей!
Теперь мне сорок семь лет.
До прошлого года я так же, как вы, нарочно старался отуманивать свои глаза вашею этою схоластикой, чтобы не видеть настоящей жизни, - и думал, что делаю хорошо.
А теперь, если бы вы знали!
Я ночи не сплю с досады, от злости, что так глупо проворонил время, когда мог бы иметь все, в чем отказывает мне теперь моя старость!
highlight.explain: Only one sentence states a number of years of his life.

highlight.question: Which sentence says what Astrov has already been sent as a reward for his forestry work?
sentences: Нет, это чрезвычайно интересно.
Михаил Львович каждый год сажает новые леса, и ему уже прислали бронзовую медаль и диплом.
Он хлопочет, чтобы не истребляли старых.
Если вы выслушаете его, то согласитесь с ним вполне.
Он говорит, что леса украшают землю, что они учат человека понимать прекрасное и внушают ему величавое настроение.
Леса смягчают суровый климат.
highlight.explain: The medal and the diploma are named in the second sentence of Sonya's speech.

highlight.question: Which sentence describes how everyone pities Yelena Andreevna because of her old husband?
sentences: Ах, и лень, и скучно!
Все бранят моего мужа, все смотрят на меня с сожалением: несчастная, у нее старый муж!
Это участие ко мне - о, как я его понимаю!
Вот как сказал сейчас Астров: все вы безрассудно губите леса, и скоро на земле ничего не останется.
Точно так вы безрассудно губите человека, и скоро благодаря вам на земле не останется ни верности, ни чистоты, ни способности жертвовать собою.
Почему вы не можете видеть равнодушно женщину, если она не ваша?
highlight.explain: Only that sentence reports the pitying looks and the words about her old husband.

highlight.question: Which sentence says how many times the doctor has been at the house since Yelena Andreevna came?
sentences: У этого доктора утомленное нервное лицо.
Интересное лицо.
Соне, очевидно, он нравится, она влюблена в него, и я ее понимаю.
При мне он был здесь уже три раза, но я застенчива и ни разу не поговорила с ним как следует, не обласкала его.
Он подумал, что я зла.
highlight.explain: The count of three visits appears only in that sentence.
